title: Massachusetts electronic-prescribing requirement
rule_summary: Prescribers generally must issue electronic prescriptions for controlled substances and medical devices, subject to statutory and regulatory exceptions and waivers.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply electronic prescriptions requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing electronic prescriptions with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
